system.description:
The Lunar sharpens her vision to supernatural acuity, her eyes drawing in every distant detail with crystalline precision. For the remainder of the scene, the Exalted doubles the effective range at which she can make out details, read text, or identify individuals, and adds two bonus dice to all sight-based Awareness rolls. Penalties for distance are halved, and the Lunar can read lips at distances where she cannot hear speech.

This basic sight enhancement is the foundation of the Lunar's visual prowess, representing the minimum development of the predator's eye that all hunters of the Silver Pact are expected to cultivate. It is a prerequisite for Eyes as Moonbeams Method, serving as the fundamental visual acuity upgrade upon which that more exotic moonlit-sight charm builds.
